scope: native macOS Terminal with matching current source pair
steps: Resume the owned populated session through /resume
Compare displayed reported-input usage at its declared precision with the latest retained Core ModelUsageBound report in that session
Verify the effective limit agrees with the runtime model/session capability
Verify omitted category measurements, tool/compaction counts and threshold are not displayed as measured zeroes
Close the view and verify unchanged task/model-call counts
Read a new owned unseen canary with a real tool, then repeat the comparison after settlement
oracle: provider input report, not session cumulative usage
current session identity only; reversed admission order protects against late older Runs
source ACL unchanged; no prompt replay or queued resurrection
no model-specific formatter, capability name matcher, or changed fixture timeout
canary_prompt: Read context-canary.txt with the read tool and report its exact content. Do not edit files or call other tools.
